### He Is Still There
Author: Dr. James Dobson
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-devotions-for-parents-by-dr-james-dobson/dr-dobson-s-parenting-devotional-aug-3.html
Passage: Psalm 120:1
Points:
- Grieving parents experience deep sorrow when facing the serious illness or loss of a child.
- God remains present and aware of our circumstances even when life feels completely overwhelmed.
- Believers can cling to faith and God's Word despite carrying difficult, unanswered questions.
- Trusting the Lord brings peace through the hope of eternal reunion in heaven.
